import (
	stdout from "@std/io/io.ms",
	monotonic from "@std/time.ms",

	close_output, now from "./helper.ms",
)

export fn main() Int:
	before := now()
	if monotonic() - before < 0.milliseconds(): return 1

	close_output()

	cause := match stdout().write(""):
		ok(_):
			return 3
		error(cause): cause

	match cause:
		Closed:
			return 0
		_:
			return 4
